description: This file defines the VisitDAO interface, which declares database access methods for handling visit entities within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and searching visits, visit types, and visit attributes, as well as related external references.

classes.name: VisitDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database access methods for visit entities, including retrieval, persistence, deletion, and search operations within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: getAllVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all visit types, with an option to include retired types.

methods.name: getVisitType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific visit type by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a specific visit type by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisitTypes
methods.description: Retrieves visit types matching a fuzzy search phrase.

methods.name: saveVisitType
methods.description: Saves or updates a visit type.

methods.name: purgeVisitType
methods.description: Removes a visit type from the database.

methods.name: getVisit
methods.description: Retrieves a visit by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a visit by its UUID.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves visits matching various filter criteria, including types, patients, locations, and date ranges.

methods.name: getVisits
methods.description: Retrieves visits based on complex search criteria encapsulated in VisitSearchCriteria object.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific visit attribute type by its ID.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a visit attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: saveVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a visit attribute type.

methods.name: deleteVisitAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a visit attribute type from the database.

methods.name: getVisitAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a visit attribute by UUID.

methods.name: getNextVisit
methods.description: Retrieves the next active visit matching certain types and starting before a specified date.
